description: Widget package: full implementation of all five source files in packages/widget/src/ plus verification that the esbuild pipeline produces a valid IIFE bundle under 30 KB gzip. Depends on FEAT-001 (npm install and tsconfig must exist first).
steps: Implement packages/widget/src/styles.ts — export const STYLES: string containing complete CSS for: (1) :host display block / reset, (2) #launcher — 56px circular button fixed bottom-right, dark background (#1a1a2e), white chat-bubble SVG icon, box-shadow, hover/active transforms, z-index 9999, (3) #panel — 380×520px fixed bottom-right panel above launcher, white background, border-radius 12px, flex column, shadow, hidden by default (transform translateY 100% + opacity 0), transition 0.25s ease, (4) #panel.open — visible state, (5) #header — gradient background matching primary color (CSS variable --primary), white text, bot name, close button, (6) #messages — flex-grow 1, overflow-y auto, padding 12px, gap 8px flex column, (7) .msg-user — self-end, primary color background, white text, border-radius 18px 18px 4px 18px, max-width 80%, padding 8px 12px, (8) .msg-bot — self-start, #f0f0f0 background, dark text, border-radius 18px 18px 18px 4px, max-width 80%, padding 8px 12px, (9) #input-row — border-top, padding 8px, flex row, gap 8px, (10) #input — flex 1, border 1px solid #ddd, border-radius 20px, padding 8px 14px, outline none, (11) #send — primary color background, white, border-none, border-radius 20px, padding 8px 18px, cursor pointer, (12) .typing — three-dot bounce animation using @keyframes, (13) scrollbar styling for #messages.

Implement packages/widget/src/context.ts — export interface PageContext { url: string; title: string; visibleText: string; }. Export function getPageContext(): PageContext { return { url: window.location.href, title: document.title, visibleText: (document.body?.innerText ?? '').slice(0, 2000) }; }.

Implement packages/widget/src/stream.ts — export interface StreamCallbacks { onToken: (token: string) => void; onDone: () => void; onError: (err: Error) => void; }. Export async function streamSSE(url: string, body: unknown, callbacks: StreamCallbacks): Promise<void>. Implementation: fetch(url, { method:'POST', headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'}, body: JSON.stringify(body) }). Check res.ok (throw on error). Get reader via res.body!.pipeThrough(new TextDecoderStream()).getReader(). Loop: read() -> accumulate buffer -> split on '\n\n' -> for each event line starting with 'data: ': if value is '[DONE]' call onDone and return, else JSON.parse and call onToken(parsed.token). Wrap outer try/catch calling onError.

Implement packages/widget/src/widget.ts — full Custom Element implementation. Class PluggableBotWidget extends HTMLElement. Private fields: shadow: ShadowRoot, apiUrl: string, botName: string, primaryColor: string, position: string, history: Array<{role:string,content:string}>, isOpen: boolean, isStreaming: boolean. constructor(): super(); this.shadow = this.attachShadow({mode:'open'}). connectedCallback(): (1) read config from document.querySelector<HTMLScriptElement>('script[data-api-url]') — apiUrl from data-api-url (default 'http://localhost:8787'), botName from data-bot-name (default 'Bot'), primaryColor from data-primary-color (default '#1a1a2e'), position from data-position (default 'bottom-right'). (2) inject <style> with STYLES + CSS variable override for --primary. (3) render launcher button HTML + panel HTML into shadow root. (4) wire event listeners: launcher click -> togglePanel(), send button click -> sendMessage(), input keydown Enter -> sendMessage(), close button -> togglePanel(). Methods: togglePanel() — toggles isOpen, adds/removes .open class on panel. sendMessage() — reads input value, trims, returns early if empty or isStreaming; appends user message to #messages and history; clears input; shows typing indicator; calls streamSSE with { message, pageContext: getPageContext(), history }; in onToken removes typing indicator (if present) and appends/updates streaming bot message element; in onDone marks isStreaming false; in onError shows error message. appendMessage(role, text) — creates div with correct class, sets textContent, appends to #messages, calls scrollToBottom(). scrollToBottom() — sets #messages.scrollTop = #messages.scrollHeight. showTyping() — appends .typing div with three spans. removeTyping() — removes .typing div if present.

Implement packages/widget/src/index.ts — import { PluggableBotWidget } from './widget.js'; if (!customElements.get('pluggable-bot-widget')) { customElements.define('pluggable-bot-widget', PluggableBotWidget); }. Add <pluggable-bot-widget></pluggable-bot-widget> auto-insertion: after DOMContentLoaded (or immediately if already loaded), append document.createElement('pluggable-bot-widget') to document.body so the embed script needs no extra HTML tag.

Run npm run build -w packages/widget and verify dist/pluggable-bot.js is produced. Run node -e "const fs=require('fs');const zlib=require('zlib');const b=fs.readFileSync('packages/widget/dist/pluggable-bot.js');const g=zlib.gzipSync(b);console.log('gzip size:',g.length,'bytes')" to confirm < 30720 bytes (30 KB).
acceptance_criteria: npx tsc --noEmit -p packages/widget/tsconfig.json exits 0 with no type errors
npm run build -w packages/widget exits 0 and produces packages/widget/dist/pluggable-bot.js
Gzipped size of dist/pluggable-bot.js is under 30720 bytes (30 KB)
dist/pluggable-bot.js is a valid IIFE that calls customElements.define when executed in a browser
All five src files are complete with no TODO stubs or empty exports
verification: npm run build -w packages/widget — exits 0, dist/pluggable-bot.js exists
findings: All five src files implemented. esbuild minified output: 8.6 KB raw, 3056 bytes gzip (well under the 30 KB limit). TypeScript strict mode: 0 errors. Bundle is an IIFE with global name PluggableBotLoader that calls customElements.define('pluggable-bot-widget', ...) on load and auto-inserts the element into document.body.
